messages:
edr-bot: ALERT: EDR detected mshta.exe spawning powershell.exe with obfuscated args on kai-laptop (HOST: kai-hp14). Action: process quarantined, network egress blocked.

maria: Oncall, please confirm isolation and kick off triage. Any user impact?

omar: I'm oncall. Confirmed isolation in EDR console — host is in network-isolate state. Kai, are you still working on it?

kai: yes, I'm at my desk. I got a prompt about a script and my laptop slowed down.

jess: Kai, disconnect ethernet/wifi and power cycle? We'll provide a loaner if needed. Do not plug any USB devices.

nina: Can we get the process tree + command line + file hash? Also need the URL if any.

edr-bot: Process tree:
```
mshta.exe (pid 4321) -> rundll32.exe (pid 4337)
mshta.exe cmdline: mshta vbscript:GetObject("script:...encoded...")
Downloaded artifact blocked: hxxp://mal.example/payload.hta (blocked by proxy)
File hash: sha256:9f2ab3c4d5e6f7890a1b2c3d4e5f67890abcdef1234567890abcdef123456b3c1
``` 
No registry persistence seen yet.

omar: Running live response to grab logs and process memory. Command sent:
```
/opt/edr/collect --host kai-hp14 --type live --include processes,network,svc,evtlog --out /tmp/kai-triage.zip
``` 
ETA ~8m.

maria: Great. SOC, treat as potential targeted payload due to mshta+obf. Start service account password rotation for any tokens that touched this host. @security-tools please rotate any KMS signing tokens accessed from this host if audit shows usage.

jess: Logged a ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-1423. Assigned to eng-security and IT. Loaner laptop prepared.

nina: Collected artifacts uploaded to secure share: s3://redwood-sec/triage/1867203456/kai-triage.zip (access logged). Yara scan shows two yara hits (scripting-encode, downloader-family).

edr-bot: Endpoint quarantine lifted temporarily for collection only. Host remains isolated from prod network.

omar: Forensic image scheduled if artifacts indicate compromise. If remediation requires reimage, we'll reprovision with fresh keys and enforce MFA. Also recommend revoking workstation certs accessible via KMS and rotating any user keys used for deployments in the last 24h.

kai: Thx, appreciate the quick help. Do I need to change my password now?

maria: Yes please change your Okta password and re-auth with 2FA. We'll confirm any lateral movement before returning device. Avoid logging into internal services from personal devices until cleared.

nina: Post-incident actions: full host reimage if any persistence or credential theft confirmed, update detection rule to catch mshta with encoded JS download, add this sample to the threat intel repo, and run org-wide scan for similar indicators.

omar: Closing loop: PIR meeting tomorrow 1300 UTC. Action owners: nina (forensics), jess (IT loaner + reimage), maria (SOC comms), omar (remediation coord). Marking INC-2026-1423 as 'investigating'.

edr-bot: ALERT STATUS: investigation in progress. Remediation actions logged. Reaction: :shield:
